## Change

- Issue, root cause and existing owner:
- Behavior changed/preserved; obsolete code, contracts and tests removed:

- Predecessor issues/commits:

## Evidence and acceptance

Link the issue's concise result; do not duplicate its full reports here.

- Exact baseline/candidate revision and dirty diff identity when applicable:
- Commands/results and inherited findings:
- Browser/performance evidence and remaining human/device acceptance:

For performance-sensitive changes:

- [ ] Comparable individual before/after results; workload/counter changes explained
- [ ] Relevant production-show/transition checks; no unreviewed baseline update
- [ ] No unresolved measured regression or undocumented accepted exception
- [ ] Required human/device acceptance for this exact candidate
- PICO: passed / failed / not tested (link evidence)

Missing evidence remains pending. Follow the [development guide](../docs/development.md)
and [performance policy](../docs/performance.md); this record is not an automated
merge restriction or permission for Git operations.
